allergen.heading: Allergens
allergen.short: Pareve, kosher ingredients. This home kitchen may also handle wheat, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, and sesame.
allergen.full: Pareve (non-dairy), made with kosher ingredients, in a home kitchen that may handle wheat, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, and sesame. Text Chana before ordering if you have an allergy.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.intro: Pickup in Pacific Beach. Nearby delivery only if Chana can do it that week.
paragraphs: She texts the pickup spot once the order is confirmed. No street address is listed here.
Delivery, when it is offered, stays near Pacific Beach and is confirmed by text.
